title: Episode About Udasi to the East

blocks.text: As Guru Nanak moved farther east, the people praised Baba Nanak for turning them away from corruption and joining them to the true Shabad. (9)
The journey then stretched through Bengal and Kamrup and onward across other eastern lands and islands, where more sangats were formed and the Guru’s path took root. (10–13)

The poet says those travels became too many to recount fully: wherever Guru Nanak placed his feet, dharamshalas arose, righteous practice was strengthened, and seekers received the grace they had come for. (14–16)
